body:
## Objective
Resolve #757 and #752 by updating `packages/review-calibration/README.md` so all CLI flags, exit-code 2 causes, the `REDESIGN.md` reference, and the CI smoke-test example match the shipped CLI.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `packages/review-calibration/README.md` Options table documents all flags from `HELP_TEXT` (`--review-cmd`, `--commit`, `--plants`, `--min-recall`, `--min-precision`, `--min-plants`, `--scorer`, `--files`, `--plants-file`, `--tier`, `--review-provider`, `--strict`, `--json`, `--prompt-only`, `--help`) and Exit codes table documents precision threshold failure and `--strict` provider match under exit code 2 — verify: `node --test packages/review-calibration/test/review-calibration.test.mjs`
2. `packages/review-calibration/README.md` replaces the broken nested-quote `node -e` smoke-test example with an executable `--scorer string` command that tokenizes cleanly without API keys, and links `REDESIGN.md` via its repository URL — verify: `node --test packages/review-calibration/test/review-calibration.test.mjs`
title: review-calibration: document all CLI flags, exit-2 causes, executable smoke-test example, and GitHub REDESIGN.md link (#757, #752)
